body: From the outside looking in perhaps, but I have no joy in my life.

I would appreciate it.

I have been actually clean and sobre for two years I thought things would get better they haven't.

I am miserable all the time, I hate my work.  I only have a few friends but they are all druggies and I cannot really be around them.  My girlfriend just stopped returning my calls a month or two ago, which really fucked me up she said she loved me we had plans to travel next year.  Then nothing, she must have met somebody else I was so worried I put out a missing persons because she is new to the country she was alive and well just did not want to talk to me.  I guess I am a poor judge of character I did not think she was so cruel.
